calls.title: Cris/Kari Intros
calls.summary: The team discussed the need for better organization in customer feedback and success efforts, identifying issues in overlapping roles and lack of systematic tracking. Cris Dizon highlighted the informal nature of current feedback gathering, which resides in platforms like Slack without centralized accountability. Squad-based feature development was noted to be rapid yet lacking coordinated oversight. Plans were proposed to create actionable roadmaps for feedback tracking. Additionally, there was an emphasis on understanding product usage better, addressing configuration complexity, and enhancing collaboration across teams. The company's small size necessitates efficient communication and coordination as employees manage multiple roles.
calls.keywords: Customer Success, Feedback Management, Product Design, Feature Prioritization, Experiment Configuration, Team Collaboration
